# Vivalr

> Vivalr is the research-peptide brand of Shandong Green International Trade Co., Ltd., a B2B supplier in Jinan, Shandong, China. The catalogue covers cosmetic and anti-aging peptides, tissue-repair and bioregulator peptides, GLOW/KLOW blend kits, and NAD+/NMN raw materials. Products are for laboratory research and formulation evaluation only — not for human or veterinary use.

Canonical domain: https://vivalr.com
Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Company
- Legal name: Shandong Green International Trade Co., Ltd.
- Address: Environmental Protection Science and Technology Park, High-Tech Zone, Jinan City, Shandong Province, China
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 15866781826
- Email: info@vivalr.com
- Business: export and sourcing of research-grade peptides and coenzymes
- Minimum order: one 10-vial kit (peptides); 10 g (bulk NMN)
- Documentation: batch COA, HPLC chromatogram, ESI-MS, SDS; third-party testing on request

## Product catalogue

### Cosmetic & Anti-Aging Peptides
- [GHK-Cu](https://vivalr.com/products/ghk-cu): CAS 89030-95-5; 50 mg × 10 vials; 100 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The benchmark copper tripeptide for collagen, ECM and skin-repair research.
- [AHK-Cu](https://vivalr.com/products/ahk-cu): CAS 682809-81-0; 50 mg × 10 vials; 100 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). A copper tripeptide studied for follicle, scalp and skin-repair signalling.
- [Snap-8](https://vivalr.com/products/snap-8): CAS 868844-74-0; 10 mg × 10 vials; 100 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). An eight-amino-acid expression-line peptide for cosmetic wrinkle research.
- [Matrixyl](https://vivalr.com/products/matrixyl): CAS 214047-00-4; 10 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). Palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 for collagen and matrix-repair research.
- [Glutathione](https://vivalr.com/products/glutathione): CAS 70-18-8; 400 mg × 10 vials; 600 mg × 10 vials; 1500 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). Reduced glutathione for antioxidant, redox and skin-brightening research.

### Repair & Bioregulator Peptides
- [BPC-157](https://vivalr.com/products/bpc-157): CAS 137525-51-0; 2 mg × 10 vials; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; 20 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). A pentadecapeptide widely used in preclinical tissue-repair research.
- [TB-500](https://vivalr.com/products/tb-500): CAS 77591-33-4; 2 mg × 10 vials; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). Thymosin beta-4 for actin dynamics, cell migration and repair research.
- [Epithalon](https://vivalr.com/products/epithalon): CAS 307297-39-8; 10 mg × 10 vials; 50 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The AEDG tetrapeptide used in telomerase and pineal-aging research.
- [Pinealon](https://vivalr.com/products/pinealon): CAS 175175-23-2; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; 20 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The EDR tripeptide studied in neuroprotection and brain-aging models.
- [KPV](https://vivalr.com/products/kpv): CAS 67727-97-3; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The alpha-MSH tripeptide fragment for inflammation and barrier research.
- [Thymosin Alpha-1](https://vivalr.com/products/thymosin-alpha-1): CAS 62304-98-7; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). A 28-amino-acid thymic peptide for immune-signalling research.

- [LL-37](https://vivalr.com/products/ll-37): CAS 154947-66-7; 5 mg × 10 vials; 5 mL × 10 vials; 10 mL × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The human cathelicidin peptide for antimicrobial and wound-repair research.

- [Cortagen](https://vivalr.com/products/cortagen): CAS 335591-03-2; 20 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). A cortical-tissue bioregulator peptide for neuroresearch.

### Blend Kits (GLOW & KLOW)
- [BPC-157 / TB-500 Blend](https://vivalr.com/products/bpc-157-tb-500-blend): CAS — (multi-component blend); 10 mg (5 + 5 mg) × 10 vials; 20 mg (10 + 10 mg) × 10 vials; 30 mg (15 + 15 mg) × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). A 1:1 repair-peptide blend supplied as a single lyophilized kit.
- [GLOW](https://vivalr.com/products/glow): CAS — (multi-component blend); 70 mg (50 + 10 + 10 mg) × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The 70 mg skin-and-repair research blend: GHK-Cu, BPC-157 and TB-500.
- [KLOW](https://vivalr.com/products/klow): CAS — (multi-component blend); 80 mg (50 + 10 + 10 + 10 mg) × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). GLOW plus KPV: an 80 mg four-peptide blend for repair and inflammation research.

### NAD+ & NMN
- [NAD+](https://vivalr.com/products/nad-plus): CAS 53-84-9; 100 mg × 10 vials; 500 mg × 10 vials; 1000 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). The central redox coenzyme for sirtuin, PARP and cellular-aging research.
- [NMN](https://vivalr.com/products/nmn): CAS 1094-61-7; 10 g; 50 g; 100 g; 1 kg; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 10 g. The NAD+ precursor for salvage-pathway and longevity research.
- [AICAR](https://vivalr.com/products/aicar): CAS 2627-69-2; 50 mg × 10 vials; 100 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). An AMPK-pathway activator for metabolic and energy-sensing research.
- [5-Amino-1MQ](https://vivalr.com/products/5-amino-1mq): CAS 42464-96-0; 5 mg × 10 vials; 10 mg × 10 vials; 50 mg × 10 vials; ≥99% (HPLC); MOQ 1 kit (10 vials). An NNMT inhibitor for metabolic and adipocyte research.
